about_pullquote: I started this because I hated being locked out myself. Now I help others get back inside fast.
about_para_1: Emersons Green Locksmith Services Ltd has been protecting Bristol homes and businesses for over 12 years. Founded locally in Emersons Green, we've built a reputation for arriving fast when people need us most — and getting the job done right, every time. Our team carries a full range of locks and keys on every visit, so most emergencies are resolved on the spot.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we answer the phone 24/7, charge fair prices, and never cause unnecessary damage to doors or frames. We're not the cheapest, but we're honest — we'll tell you what needs doing and why, and we stand behind every job with a guarantee. Half our work comes from repeat customers and referrals, which tells you everything you need to know.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out in the middle of the night with no shoes on. Called Emersons Green and the lad was here in 25 minutes. He got me in without damaging the door and charged a fair price. Absolute legend. Won't call anyone else.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We use them for our office building when tenants get locked out. They're reliable, professional, and always turn up when they say they will. Best locksmith in Bristol by miles.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: Had a broken lock on the back door. They came out the next day, fitted a new deadbolt, and it looks great. Good quality work, reasonable price, and friendly bloke. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James M.
